# Sign-In Requirements Checklist: Per-Person Web Google Sign-In for the Generator

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the sign-in and admission requirements (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability) before `/speckit-tasks`. Hosting is out of scope, so this checklist also tests that no hosting requirement has crept back in.
**Created**: 2026-10-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scope Boundary (sign-in only)

- [x] CHK001 Does every remaining requirement avoid depending on a hosted server, cloud secret store, container or deployment step? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK002 Are the hosting-related deferrals in the plan and research (`FTM_HOSTED`, research R8/R10/R11) clearly marked as not delivered by this feature, so tasks can't be generated for them? [Consistency, Plan §Summary, Research]
- [x] CHK003 Is it stated which web addresses must be registered with the sign-in configuration for this feature to work (local now, hosted later), without requiring the hosted one? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK004 Is the "one process" constraint (in-process lock and pending store) documented as a requirement the hosting work must respect? [Dependency, Plan §Constraints]

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for what the person sees in the sign-in tab after each outcome (success, refused, cancelled, failed, link already used), not only in the generator tab? [Gap, Contract web-signin §Callback]
- [x] CHK006 Is the behaviour defined when the person denies the Google consent screen (cancels at Google) rather than closing the tab? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for a sign-in that is partially completed when the one-run lock is held by someone else? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "Two people press Generate at once"]
- [x] CHK008 Is the set of Google permissions requested at sign-in specified, and matched to what the pipeline needs? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Contract pipeline-credentials §Scopes]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for an existing `token.json` on a developer machine whose permissions are narrower than the new set? [Gap, Contract pipeline-credentials §Scopes]
- [x] CHK010 Are the setup-error conditions enumerated (missing file, unreadable file, invalid contents, https rule) rather than described only as "missing or invalid"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Is the required README/CLAUDE.md documentation for obtaining `client_secret_web.json` stated as a requirement? [Gap, Plan §Source Code]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Is "belongs to curiouslearning.org, as confirmed by Google" defined precisely enough to decide every case (verified email, managing organization, email domain), with the three conditions listed as all required? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Research R3]
- [x] CHK013 Is "page session" defined so that a reload, a duplicated tab and a new browser window are each unambiguously classified? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK014 Is "usable once only" (FR-003) defined for both the callback step and the generator's consumption of the result, so a replay at either step is covered? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §PendingSignIn]
- [x] CHK015 Is the 3-minute sign-in timeout stated once, with the same value, in the spec, data model and contract? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model, Contract web-signin]
- [x] CHK016 Are the three "Authentication failed" reasons in FR-006 worded exactly as they will be shown, and do the contract's messages match them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Contract web-signin §Callback]
- [x] CHK017 Is it unambiguous whether the sign-in link opens a new tab or replaces the generator tab, and is that stated in the spec and not only in research R2? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1, Research R2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK018 Does FR-007 ("choose a different account") hold together with FR-009 (a sign-in lasts the whole session), i.e. is it stated that a refused attempt leaves the session not signed in? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK019 Do FR-010 ("no sign-in again within a session") and SC-006 ("next Generate always asks Google" after a closed tab or restart) use the same definition of session end? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK020 Is the pipeline's own email re-check (defence in depth) consistent with FR-004, so it can never admit an account the app refused, nor refuse one the app admitted? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract pipeline-credentials §Output]
- [x] CHK021 Does FR-012 (spec 004 flow unchanged) conflict with replacing the "open the sign-in page" link by a button that opens a new tab? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, Contract web-signin]
- [x] CHK022 Are the "Authentication cancelled" (timeout/tab closed) and "Authentication failed" (refused/failed) outcomes consistently distinguished across spec, contract and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §Edge Cases, Quickstart V6]

## Security Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Is the threat each guard addresses stated (forged token, look-alike address, copied link, reused link, another session's result), so each guard can be traced to a requirement? [Traceability, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, Research R3/R4]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for what must never be logged or shown on screen (tokens, client secret), given that logs are downloadable? [Gap, Contract web-signin §Callback]
- [x] CHK025 Is it a stated requirement that the AI-check process never receives the person's Google access? [Completeness, Contract pipeline-credentials §Not passed]
- [x] CHK026 Is the fallback when the same-browser cookie check turns out not to be feasible specified, including how the spec must be updated if it is dropped? [Assumption, Research R4]
- [x] CHK027 Is the "Internal" consent-screen setting clearly an extra layer and not something the admission requirement depends on? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK028 Can SC-001 ("under 1 minute, including sign-in") be measured from a defined start and end point? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK029 Can SC-005 ("understands why … from the single message") be objectively verified, or does it need a concrete criterion (the message names the requirement and the retry action)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK030 Does SC-002's list of account types to test cover every refusal class named in FR-004 (other org, personal Gmail, look-alike, Drive-shared outsider)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK031 Does every functional requirement FR-001–FR-016 have at least one quickstart scenario or acceptance scenario that would detect its absence? [Traceability, Quickstart V1–V13]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK032 Is the expected behaviour defined when Google returns no refresh token (e.g. re-consent not forced), given the "access expires during a long run" edge case? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Research R5]
- [x] CHK033 Is the behaviour defined when several languages are queued and the sign-in is refused or cancelled before the first one? [Coverage, Contract web-signin §Generator tab]
- [x] CHK034 Is the behaviour defined when the generator tab closes after a successful callback but before the result is consumed? [Edge Case, Data Model §PendingSignIn]
- [x] CHK035 Are the edge cases "Curious Learning account without Drive access" and "Google unverified-app warning" still reachable under an Internal consent screen, or should they be marked as conditional? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Is the dependency on a Google Cloud project administrator (creating the Web client, registering `http://localhost:8501/`) recorded as a blocking prerequisite with an owner? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Quickstart §Prerequisites]
- [x] CHK037 Is the assumption that `st.context.cookies` can read a script-set cookie on the installed Streamlit version flagged for verification before implementation? [Assumption, Research R4]
- [x] CHK038 Is the "no new dependencies" claim backed by naming which pinned package provides each sign-in capability? [Traceability, Research R9]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
